items.label: [SURPRISE GIFT PACKAGE]
items.value: Upgraded large panel furniture dolly set, including four 6.5 x 6.5 in moving dolly,1 x pry bar,4 x heightening spacers,4 x flannel non-slip mats,2 x rubber anti-slip mats,1 x pair of safety gloves,1 drawstring storage bag.

items.label: [HIGH QUALITY MATERIAL]
items.value: Heavy duty dolly made of thickened carbon steel,not easily deformed,reinforced steel base,widened and thickened silent rubber wheels can move flexibly without hurting the floor,longer carbon steel pry bar can save your strength and lift objects easily.

items.label: [SECURITY PROTECTION]
items.value: The pry bar can be pasted with self-adhesive rubber anti-slip pads,which can prevent objects from falling off and protect them from being scratched when lifting them;4 self-adhesive velvet anti-slip pads are pasted on furniture mover dolly panels,which can effectively keep objects from slipping during transportation.

items.label: [NEW UPGRADED DESIGN]
items.value: Furniture dolly with wheels uses a larger load-bearing panel with a fifth wheel in the center to increase the load-bearing capacity;designed with L-shaped retaining edge,not easy to slip off during handling,with two locking switches can be fixed at any time,anti-pressure handle tow hook can effectively protect fingers.

items.label: [WIDELY USED]
items.value: When you have this moving tool,you can use it to move all kinds of furniture and appliances,such as beds,sofas,tables,closets,refrigerators,washing machines,etc.;you can easily move objects,suitable for applicable wood floors,tile floors and low-pile carpets,etc
